variants.name: Chain
variants.collider: none (or a thin capsule if it must stop the rope/cards)

attach.pivot: top attach point = top of the iron ring (0,0,0); hangs along -Z
attach.bottom_attach: inside of the J-hook bowl (lantern bail hangs here)
attach.repeat: stack copies: next chain ring hangs in the hook (pivot at bottom_attach_z)

variants.notes: 6 uneven octagonal links (square section, alternating 90 deg, swing/jitter, bulged sides, forge-weld bumps), rust flakes, open upper half-link with a round hanging ring, forged J-hook on an eye at the bottom; Props `iron`/`dark`.
